title: Microbial Responses to Temperature, Osmotic and pH Stress
method: Count whitespace-delimited words within visible teaching paragraphs before Part B, excluding headings, diagrams/captions, tables, practice, references and UI. Article includes revealed answers, headings, tables, captions and references, excluding SVG and diagram buttons. Worked examples count distinct quantitative teaching paragraphs (one compares two scenarios).
